pairs.summary: KLF4 and ZNF684 motifs co-occur in the same accessible ~300 bp windows more often than expected after matching GC, accessibility and repeat content, in 10 of 14 profiles analysed (786-O clear-cell renal carcinoma; A549 lung adenocarcinoma; HT-29 colorectal adenocarcinoma; HepG2 hepatoblastoma/liver cancer; ...). Median lift 1.35x, typical spacing ~51 bp between sites. In 10 profile(s) the enrichment is seen in both replicate halves and the motifs are distinguishable. This is a sequence-level hypothesis to test (e.g. ChIP/CUT&RUN co-binding, motif mutagenesis), not a confirmed interaction. Evidence: motif co-occurrence only; ChromBPNet contribution scores did not highlight both sites (2 profile(s) tested); no significant ablation synergy. RNA layer (donor-aware within-donor metacell r): HepG2 (hepatocyte, proxy match): CELLxGENE no significant co-expression, Tabula Sapiens unassessed; K562 (erythroid myeloid progenitor, proxy match): CELLxGENE no significant co-expression, Tabula Sapiens no significant co-expression.

CCLA_K562.mapping_note: proxy: K562 (CML erythroleukemia line) -> normal erythroid/MEP/CMP progenitors
